name: Frost-Whisker Carp
journal_prompt: An ancient fish species possessing natural antifreeze glycoproteins, glowing with a pale blue light beneath glacial ice.
notes: **Moved off `lava_field`**, with the seals and the petrels and for the same reason. A frost-whiskered fish on warm basalt is the same import artefact, and the Shambala ice-pike it sits beside in the bestiary went to the snow in the same pass.
